title: onboarding-deck-screenshot-storyboards-for-sales-demo
creator: Maris Vega
description: Create a set of slide-ready visuals derived from live product screenshots to tell a concise onboarding story for sales and solution teams. Focus on annotated step frames, hero screen variants (desktop / tablet / mobile), cropped callout assets for slide templates, and social/thumbnail sizes. Ensure exports are screen-resolution safe, free of customer PII, and include accessible alt text and contrast checks.
deliverables: 6 hero slide variants (desktop, tablet, mobile; light/dark)
12 annotated step-by-step screenshot frames with callouts and short captions
4 cropped asset packs for slide templates (16:9 hero, 4:3 detail, 1:1 thumbnail, 1200x628 social)
interactive Figma prototype of the deck flow for sales demos
export zip: PNG@2x, SVG (UI elements), source Figma file, slide deck draft
artboard_naming: DeckHero_Desktop_v1, DeckStep_01_Annot, DeckCrop_1200x628_v1 - follow this tokenized pattern for versioning
export_spec: Hero PNG 1920x1080 @2x, Detail PNG 1200x800, Thumbnails 800x800, Social 1200x628; SVGs for icons; include one high-quality JPG for marketing where file size is a concern. Include a README in the export zip with alt text and copy suggestions.
